suggested_request: Prepare a release-readiness brief for Project Atlas and draft the update I should share with the launch team.
recommended_action: Keep the July 29 beta target provisional. Assign owners to the open API and onboarding blockers, then publish a revised go/no-go update after both are cleared.

sources.title: GitHub release status
sources.content: The release branch is green on all required checks. Issue #184, an intermittent API timeout under load, remains open and is labeled launch-blocker.

sources.content: ATLAS-27, the onboarding copy and legal review, is still in progress. Maya owns the issue and expects a decision by July 25.
